_meta.unfrozen_note: UNFROZEN 2026-06-22 (project directive). The original 10 were frozen; the 6 atlas-sourced archetypes below (steel I-beam, corten container panel, marine sailcloth, PP cargo net, recycled HDPE sheet, recycled shade-cloth) are drawn from real BCN reclaimed streams in the internal material atlas (not published) (named operator + verified distance). Each carries a matching deterministic rule in src/inventory/classifier.py. solar_transmissivity on the new archetypes is a DECLARED honest estimate (the atlas gives no shade factor) — revisit per deployment.
_meta.carbon_boundary: Recycled cut-off. Manufacturing carbon = 0 (ASSUMED, ISO 14044 §4.3.4). Transport only.

field_notes.unit: Quantity basis for cost_per_unit and dimensions.unit_mass_kg. One of: metre, unit, m2.
field_notes.theme: Soft-filter tags for Phase 5 (Phase 1 enum: maritime, natural, industrial, urban). One material may carry several.
field_notes.transport_mode_factor: kgCO2e per tonne-km, road freight. NOW SOURCED 2026-06-22: 0.09752 = DEFRA/DESNZ 2024 'All HGVs, average laden' (GROUNDED). Replaced the prior 0.10 placeholder (near-identical → validated it).
field_notes.cost_per_unit: EUR. Real Spain/EU market price (Phase-2 research, 2026-06-22). Basis (buy / rental-day / reclaim) recorded per material in materials_provenance.json. Reclaimed streams (billboard vinyl, yacht shrink-wrap, marine sailcloth) ≈ €0 + transport. ES listings ex-VAT.
field_notes.solar_transmissivity: Fraction 0–1 of solar radiation passing through the membrane (derived from the source doc shade factors: transmissivity ≈ 1 − shade_factor). null for structural-only materials and for non-overhead covers (PP carpet). Drives the Phase 5b cooling correction per the 2026-06-09 Golden Rule amendment. HDPE shade net is knit-selectable (30–90% shade); a mid value is used — revisit per deployment.

_meta.golden_rule: AMENDED 2026-06-09. Cooling = geometry × (1 − solar_transmissivity) correction. Carbon stays material-only. See the project PRD (not published) §1 and Phase 5b.
_meta.transport_mode_factor: 0.09752 kgCO2e/tonne-km — DEFRA/DESNZ 2024 'All HGVs, average laden' (GROUNDED, replaces the prior 0.10 placeholder; near-identical, validates it).
_meta.specs_provenance: Physical specs sourced from real manufacturer datasheets/EPDs (Phase-2 earn-the-data); distances are OSRM road routes to Parc del Fòrum; carbon factor is DEFRA 2024; cost_per_unit is real Spain/EU market price (basis buy/rental/reclaim per material in the ledger; reclaim streams ≈ free + transport). Per-(material,field) tier ledger in data/materials_provenance.json. Caveats: recycled-content of the HDPE knit shade-cloth is DECLARED (no credible recycled-knit datasheet); the recycled PE tarp is the IFRC Eco-Design ≥15%-recycled product; marine-sailcloth reuse is GROUNDED (Sail to Shelter), physical specs from virgin Dacron.
